# PlaceOS Backoffice

> Backoffice is the administration app of PlaceOS, a building automation platform. Administrators use it to manage the systems, modules, drivers, zones, triggers, domains and users of a PlaceOS instance. All pages need a PlaceOS account with admin or support access.

The app has no public content. Use the documentation and the API references below to learn about PlaceOS and Backoffice.

## Documentation

- [Backoffice overview](https://docs.placeos.com/placeos/overview/backoffice/): What Backoffice is and what each section does
- [PlaceOS overview](https://docs.placeos.com/placeos/overview/): The parts of PlaceOS and how they connect
- [Add a domain](https://docs.placeos.com/placeos/how-to/backoffice/add-domain/): Set up a new domain in Backoffice
- [PlaceOS reference](https://docs.placeos.com/placeos/reference/): Reference material for PlaceOS

## API

- [PlaceOS REST API](https://placeos.github.io/rest-api-swagger-ui/): The engine API that Backoffice uses
- [Staff API](https://placeos.github.io/staff-api-swagger-ui/): The API for bookings, events and staff

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/PlaceOS/backoffice): The Backoffice repository on GitHub
